title: Iron To Copper
description: Replaces iron tools and armor with copper tools and armor from the latest update (1.21.9).
body:
## What is this pack about?
Being self-explanatory, this resource pack takes the texture of iron tools and armor and replaces them with the copper tools and armor from the latest update, The Copper Age (1.21.9). **Allowing you to have Copper Equipment in a previous version with needing mods for it.**

### How can this be useful to me?
This can be useful if you were in a version that don't have the copper tools and armor without planning to update, wanting to have the look of copper in an earlier version, this pack would allow that to happen being great for both survival and creative players when possibly for instance, making a thumbnail for their video.
